detail.title: 32CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5832S-I3 32CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P 2U 8HDDs WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 32-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 5M-N@20fps/1080p@25fps Encoding Capability • Max. 48-ch IP Video Input (Up to 8MP) • AI Functions: 2-ch QuickPick 2.0, 2-ch FR, 8-ch Perimeter Protection, 32-ch SMD, 16-ch AI Coding • 8 Bays. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Mode: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Mode: 8 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels(up to 12 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 32 channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

AI Video Quality Analytics.AI Video Quality Analytics by Recorder: 32 channels: Supports detecting brightness levels, color cast, defocus, overexposure, contrast levels, black and white

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 48 channels of IPC access 16 IP channels by default +32 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 192 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 192 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 192 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, SMD, Perimeter Protection and QuickPick 2.0 cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Encode Enhancement disabled： Main stream: Channels 1-4 and 17-20 5M-N@(1 fps–25 fps), others 5M-N@(1 fps–12 fps); Channels 1-4 and 17-20 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–30 fps), others 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–30 fps); Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps); Encode Enhancement enabled： Main stream: Channels 1-8 and 17-24 5M-N@(1 fps–20 fps), others 5M-N@(1 fps-12 fps); (4 channels can be transformed to 5MP@6 fps) Channels 1-8 and 17-24 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–25 fps), others 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–30 fps); Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps); *When Encode Enhancement is enabled, Video Quality Analytics, Scene Changing, Face Recognition, Face Detection, Perimeter Protection and QuickPick 2.0 cannot be used.
Audio and Video.Video Output: 2 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 CVBS HDMI1: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA/HDMI2: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Heterogeneous video sources output for HDMI 2 is configurable.
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; alarm; motion detection; intelligent; POS
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; local alarm; alarm box; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); local alarm output; IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Disk Interface: 8 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.
Ports.USB: 4 (2 front USB 2.0 ports, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports)

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
